answer: Bind voting weight to a slowly vesting compute bond: each identity must keep posting unique jury-scored work whose embedding plume stays outside a similarity radius of its sibling keys. Batches that share an umber template fingerprint forfeit the bond together. An attacker spinning N clones pays N bonds plus N distinct generation costs, and one correlated cluster collapses the set like karst under a single audit sinkhole, so farm cost scales roughly with N.
